description: This script manages telemetry data upload, including handling retries, selecting connection methods (Direct or Codebig), and uploading via HTTP or TFTP. It also manages resending failed uploads and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: getTelemetryEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the telemetry upload URL from RFC or response file.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Checks for Codebig availability and configures connection type.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data via direct HTTP or TFTP.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data via Codebig connection.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Fetches the IPv4 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Fetches the IPv6 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file to prevent multiple instances.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct connection is blocked (currently disabled).
